theme_strategy.archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY / FINANCIAL PRECISION (Alpine Emerald & Warm Slate)
theme_strategy.aesthetic_description: Clean Italian financial utility combining precision accounting clarity with warm stone tones and rich alpine emerald accents. Emphasizes peace of mind against missed month-end invoices.

entry_surfaces./: split hero and PIN gate — clean financial positioning left with key metric teasers, tactile 4-to-6 digit PIN entry card on the right
entry_surfaces./dashboard: financial command center — top urgent month-end reminder banner, summary KPI widgets, search and filter tabs, structured RiBa ledger data table with action drawer

rules.body: font-sans text-base text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed tracking-normal
rules.overline_labels: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

grids_and_layouts.kpi_bar: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6
grids_and_layouts.table_container: bg-white dark:bg-[#131C2E] rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm overflow-hidden
grids_and_layouts.banner_layout: rounded-xl border p-5 mb-6 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 transition-all duration-200

motion.transitions: transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease
motion.modal_animation: scale-[0.98] to scale-100 with opacity fade (200ms ease-out)
motion.banner_pulse: subtle ring highlight for urgent end-of-month reminders

accessibility.contrast_standard: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for all body & data text, 3:1 for large headers)
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full tab order with visible ring-2 ring-teal-600 focus outlines on inputs, buttons, and table action triggers
accessibility.aria_roles: aria-live for reminder banner counts, aria-describedby on form validation inputs

key_features_and_business_logic.language: Italian (it-IT formatting for dates: dd/MM/yyyy and currency: € #.##0,00)
key_features_and_business_logic.pin_authentication: 4 to 6 digit security PIN stored securely in localStorage / session cookie, with quick unlock, reset PIN option, and instant auth check

end_of_month_reminder.trigger_condition: Active on the last 3 calendar days of the current month OR if there are RiBa from previous months still missing invoices ('da fatturare')
end_of_month_reminder.behavior: Sticky/prominent alert banner at top of dashboard with count, total sum da fatturare, quick 1-click filter button 'Vedi Da Fatturare', and direct 'Segna Fattura' actions

riba_attributes: stato_fattura (boolean: true if fattura emessa, false if da fatturare)
key_features_and_business_logic.export_or_quick_actions: Instant search by cliente, quick status toggle, edit modal, delete confirmation, and export to CSV/print

instructions_to_main_agent: Language MUST be entirely in Italian (labels, buttons, placeholder texts, validation messages, toast notifications).
Use formatCurrency helper for Italian currency format (e.g. 1.250,50 €).

Ensure end-of-month banner logic accurately checks: (1) if today is within the last days of the month (e.g. today >= 28th), OR (2) if any pending RiBa has data_caricamento_banca or data_scadenza from a previous month.

Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, filter tabs, stats cards, and action items (e.g. data-testid='add-riba-btn', data-testid='pin-input', data-testid='tab-da-fatturare', data-testid='reminder-banner').
Ensure the UI uses the clean Outfit + Plus Jakarta Sans font pairing and robust, high-contrast Tailwind classes with full dark mode support.
